definition: Non-Facility Associated Signalling lets one signaling channel control multiple digital telephony interfaces instead of requiring a separate signaling channel on each one.
entry_text: Non-Facility Associated Signalling lets one signaling channel control multiple digital telephony interfaces instead of requiring a separate signaling channel on each one.
example: A carrier uses a shared signaling channel for several ISDN primary-rate spans.
label: Non-Facility Associated Signalling
